# CubicalGolfer.com

> Independent golf gear reviews for weekend and desk-job golfers. Every rated product is bought with our own money and tested on-course — no sponsors, no free review units. Research picks are labeled as such and carry no rating.

## Start Here

- [How We Test](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/how-we-test/): The protocol behind every rating — rounds played, what gets measured, what disqualifies a product.
- [About](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/about/): Who runs the site and why a 10-handicap desk golfer's testing is the point.
- [Gear Reviews Hub](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/gear-reviews/): Every buying guide and review, organized by category.
- [Comparisons Hub](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/compare/): All head-to-head product matchups.
- [Tools Hub](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/tools/): Interactive calculators and finders.

## Buying Guides

- [Best Golf Rangefinders](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/best-golf-rangefinders-2026/): Eight picks, five tested on-course, from $149 budget to premium.
- [Best Golf Launch Monitors](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/best-golf-launch-monitors-2026/): Nine options from $199 to $4,999, segmented by budget and use case.
- [Best Golf Irons](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/best-golf-irons-2026/): Eight sets by handicap level, five tested on-course.
- [Best Putters](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/best-golf-putters-2026/): Nine putters across blade, mallet, and zero-torque, tested on real greens.
- [Most Forgiving Drivers](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/best-golf-drivers-forgiveness/): Eight drivers ranked for mishit tolerance, five tested.
- [Best Golf Balls](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/best-golf-balls-2026/): Ranked by swing speed with compression matching.
- [How to Choose Golf Ball Compression](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/how-to-choose-golf-ball-compression/): Three steps from swing speed to a specific ball, with picks for each speed band.
- [Best Golf Balls Under $30](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/best-golf-balls-under-30/): Six balls under $30/dozen and exactly what the cheap ball costs you.
- [Best Golf Balls Under $40](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/best-golf-balls-under-40/): The price band where urethane covers become affordable.
- [Best Golf Balls for Beginners](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/best-golf-balls-for-beginners/): Soft, straight and cheap enough to lose — plus the mistake that costs new golfers most.
- [Best Golf Drivers Under $400](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/best-golf-drivers-under-400/): Previous-season premium drivers at budget prices.
- [Best Golf Shoes](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/best-golf-shoes/): Spiked, spikeless, and walking picks.
- [Best Golf Simulators](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/best-golf-simulators/): Complete setups ranked by budget tier.

- [Pro V1 vs Chrome Soft](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/compare/titleist-pro-v1-vs-callaway-chrome-soft/): Premium ball comparison by distance, spin, and feel.

## Tools & Calculators

- [Golf Ball Finder](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/golf-ball-finder/): Two questions to a three-ball shortlist matched to swing speed.
- [Golf Ball Compression Chart](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/golf-ball-compression-chart/): 34 balls charted by compression with photos and picks.
- [Handicap Calculator](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/golf-handicap-calculator/): Official-method handicap from as few as three scores.
- [Club Distance Calculator](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/club-distance-calculator/): Map real gaps across every club in the bag.
- [Projector Distance Calculator](https://www.cubicalgolfer.com/golf-simulator-projector-distance-calculator/): Throw-ratio math for garage sim builds.
